executable_actions.rationale: The current executed checker has already localized the earliest failure to incomplete multilayer real-weight binding. Use the passed complete checkpoint catalog as read-only authority, derive an explicit missing/duplicate per-layer slice, and repair only the existing board AXI/DDR loader, generated integration harness, binding manifest, and their references. This is a verification-capability/integration repair, not a connected-kernel or hardware-correctness repair. A targeted rerun of case_multilayer_pipeline is required before any exact-board interface or simulator action becomes eligible.

observations: The earliest decisive current execution failure is real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline: the DUT binding does not cover every Transformer-block weight in every target layer. real_weight_provenance.all_target_layers is false, and the twelve listed consumed-tensor hashes are not complete-scope evidence.

The issue is currently a board-level loader/binding verification-capability gap, not proven RTL-core liveness, value, ordering, or protocol failure. functional_sim is failed as an aggregate because its prerequisite VCS gate did not run to completion; semantic numeric comparison is explicitly not_run.

The board VCS elaboration diagnosis cannot be selected as the next action because the current gate DAG blocks case_axi_ddr_interface and case_vcs_functional_sim behind case_multilayer_pipeline. Its prior elaboration evidence remains planning evidence until prerequisites pass and a fresh exact-source run re-establishes it.

The exact user sample wrapper identity has passed and is immutable: source identity sha256 37ebe27a4d9293741131ba64432dc6e71a10c10570780d03dbec910eee555e66, selected source closure sha256 6665a9df4e0b86fdbd47c48e76b63137069f4c2505d914d6ceee233447a1c5c5, and compute-slot ABI sha256 dac5c980fa4cb0ae1719e575c78ede9bff33fc35f9aaeec60cc8baa9b0c9836b.

The expected output is already sourced from real target-model inference with sha256 92fc53de80c8caca6ea04cc69ab768a1f6db0e55a2ab0ebbd9ac0adc6e3c85b4. It must not be regenerated from random data or DUT output and must remain unchanged during this repair.

The connected-kernel replay is closed hash-bound evidence: it observed accepted start/ingress, all 1792 expected ingress beats, 1792 accepted egress beats, terminal last, 416 accepted boundary records, and passing boundary liveness. No current board trace names a contradiction to those invariants.

The connected kernel remains certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline; strict same-cycle stage start or completion is not required. Nothing in the current static loader-coverage failure challenges its boundary order or cross-token overlap evidence.
The conditional design-team review returned no_split and supplied no independent specialist action. This does not replace deterministic checker evidence and does not authorize promotion.

Authoritative SACG memory truth has 17 active contamination barriers, six open retry requests, and no scoped open backtrack request. The barriers and retries require bounded repair followed by Stage7 re-verification; they remain downstream-consumption blockers and must not be silently cleared by this repair plan.
proposed_actions: Execute exactly one bounded action: localize the missing per-layer Transformer-block tensor bindings, repair the existing agent-created exact-board AXI/DDR loader/binding projection without changing immutable contracts or sample-project sources, and rerun only case_multilayer_pipeline. Stop after that result and return control to Stage7; do not run connected-kernel replay, case_axi_ddr_interface, VCS, or downstream board gates in this action.
risks: Model/shape coverage risk: an incorrect target-layer count or tensor-name-to-layer mapping could produce a superficially complete manifest while omitting required block tensors or duplicating tensors across layers.

Memory/runtime risk: repairing only catalog metadata without binding the same hashes to the executable AXI/DDR load schedule and loader harness would not prove that the DUT can consume the intended weights.
Lifecycle risk: the later runtime trace must prove every target layer is loaded exactly once in order and that kernel start does not occur before the required load completes.
Board identity risk: modifying or substituting the exact user sample wrapper, its source closure, compute-slot ABI, or discovered Vivado authority would invalidate board-level acceptance.

Numeric and data-order risk: changing stimulus, target-model reference, tolerance, canonical packing, token order, or semantic testbench contract would contaminate the repair comparison and is prohibited.

Scope risk: embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, or sampling could be incorrectly added to the binding requirement even though they are outside the Transformer-block accelerator DUT.

Evidence risk: a passing case_multilayer_pipeline result is only a prerequisite/static capability result; board functional, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, liveness, numeric, and executed full-weight-consumption claims remain unavailable until later real-tool runs pass.

Causal-selection risk: repairing generated RTL from the prior elaboration symptom before clearing the current loader-coverage gate could address a stale or downstream symptom rather than the earliest current blocker.

constraints: Repair only the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system loader/binding capability identified by the current executed failure.
Require every in-scope Transformer-block tensor in every target layer to be hash-bound; exclude embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, and sampling.
Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected output, numeric policy and tolerance, semantic testbench contract, and exact user sample wrapper/source hashes immutable.
Do not treat manifest presence or a static binding pass as proof of runtime DUT consumption; dynamic complete-scope consumption evidence remains required in later exact-board simulation.
Do not reopen operator-leaf or connected-kernel scopes without a new current hash-bound board trace explicitly contradicting a named certified invariant.
Preserve the connected kernel's elastic rate-insensitive token ordering and overlap semantics.
Keep all active SACG contamination barriers in force until a subsequent Stage7 verification result passes the applicable gates.
